name: Monmouth Beach – Fossil Hunting (Dorset day trip)
scope: One undated self-guided outing; no dated event or tour added. Exeter region denotes the directory audience, not the actual locality, which is Lyme Regis, Dorset.

sources.evidence: Museum visitor guide describes the ammonite pavement and small fossils in loose gravel that visitors can collect; warns about unstable cliffs and slippery seaweed.
Local visitor board confirms Monmouth Beach and ammonite pavement at low tide; tide checks required.
Council maintains this public pebble beach; no beach admission booking is specified.

Parking charges are separate. Pin uses the council-linked DT7 3LE Google Maps destination (50.7194904, -2.9454451) as an approximate start/car-park area. Do not use the map viewport centre. No precise parking tariff published here because the council labels that column 2025/26.

image.creator: Dylan Moore
image.modification: Original JPEG; visual crop by card CSS only. Not current conditions.

safety: Leave embedded ammonites, pavement and ledges intact. No cliff excavation or hammering promoted. Tides, weather, unstable cliffs, slippery seaweed and adult supervision stated; age guidance TBC.
map: 3 existing Charmouth points plus 1 Monmouth start-area point. Nearby points cluster at wider zoom. Not guaranteed finds or a walking route.
